title: Tart Cucumber Keto Delight
description: A refreshing keto snack made with tart cucumber and a touch of oozy chocolate. Perfect for a hot summer day.

ingredients.name: tart
ingredients.amount: 1 pre-made (or 1 cup of almond flour and 1/4 cup of sugar substitute to make a crust)

instructions: Prepare the tart crust according to the recipe or package instructions.
Slice the cucumber into thin rounds.
Arrange the cucumber slices in the tart crust.
Drizzle the oozy chocolate over the cucumber slices.
Bake the tart in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool before serving.
